metaDescription: Re-indent Java by brace depth with 4 spaces, indent switch cases, keep text blocks and comments, and optionally break one-line code.
intro: Fixes indentation, blank lines and optionally line breaks in Java code without sending it anywhere.
why:
Messy indentation hides the structure of Java code, and minified or copy-pasted code is worse. A re-indenter gives you the block layout back quickly.

The tool reads your code with a small scanner that knows strings, comments and raw literals, so braces inside them are ignored. It then sets the indent from bracket depth and, if you ask, puts a line break after braces and semicolons. It is not google-java-format.
howTo: Pick the indent and line break mode.
Use your build's formatter for team style.

faq.q: Is this the same as google-java-format?
faq.a: No. Formatters such as google-java-format also wrap lines and sort imports. This tool re-indents and optionally breaks lines only.

faq.q: Will it change what my code does?
faq.a: It only changes whitespace outside strings, comments and raw literals. Test results: the non-whitespace text was unchanged on all test files, and re-running the tool gave the same output. Review the diff anyway.
Wrapping needs a full parser. This tool does not have one.
No. Everything runs in your browser and nothing is uploaded.
